scope: Independent source re-review of only the six changed toddler daily-care placements in frozen r06: coat flip, toileting, meals, food on floor, teeth and pacifier change. Every exact public field and each listed topic row was adjudicated. All six have no art.

originalSource.authority: Original supplied PDF identified by research/foundation/SOURCE_MANIFEST.md. This reviewer independently read the logged original pages; author and research evidence are pointers only.

priorReview.relationship: Same independent source reviewer. r01 remains immutable. Only this reviewer’s two source findings are resolved here, against inspected r06 replacements.

reviewMethod: Read the exact six r06 snapshots and actual HomeStudy rendered entry text and every topic row. Verified the unchanged HomeStudy/catalog renderer bindings and reread the entry/topic rendering logic. Reread every cited original PDF page directly in bounded, untruncated full-text outputs, the complete dressing, eating, sleeping, brushing, toileting and pacifier units, and the cited demonstration, chart, translation and appendix pages. Reinspected readable full original pages for the coat diagram, complete chart rows, callouts and sensitive continuation context. Relevant broader context from this same reviewer’s actual r01 original reads is explicitly linked below; no author research or another reviewer’s read was treated as this reviewer’s own. No tone report was inspected. The judgments are source fidelity judgments for this exact narrow public prose, not approval of omitted care methods or medical certification.
